ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Map D is located on the far right; the figure has a graticule, with longitude marked at about 130°E and the latitude line around 32°N; the sea-land outline appears as a coastal area near islands and peninsulas in southwestern Japan, and the black triangle in the figure indicates a volcano location. Reasoning: Based on the latitude-longitude position and island coastline outline of map D, it can be judged that location D corresponds to a volcanic area in southwestern Japan or near the Japanese archipelago. Therefore, the distinctive landscape that can also be enjoyed near location D is land reclamation projects.
